records.failureSummary: Verified the store.update/store.remove test suite and demonstrated red-first behavior. test/store.test.mjs contains AC-numbered tests [AC-01]-[AC-07] exercising store.update(id, patch) and store.remove(id) directly through the public store API using only the existing node:test and node:assert/strict (no new framework or dependency). Coverage: update with title only [AC-01], done only [AC-02], both fields [AC-03]; updated object returned with only provided fields changed and other todos isolated [AC-04]; update with a nonexistent id does not throw [AC-05]; remove of an existing id makes the todo unavailable via get and list and removes only the target [AC-06]; remove with a nonexistent id does not throw [AC-07]. To address the prior red-light/vacuous-tests finding, I reproduced the pre-implementation placeholder store in a scratch directory outside the workspace (product code untouched) and ran the same test file against it: 9 tests, 0 passed, 9 failed with errors such as Got unwanted exception. Actual message: remove not implemented, proving the tests genuinely fail without the implementation. Against the current workspace the suite is green: node --test reports 11 tests, 11 passed, 0 failed. npm run lint and npm run build are both clean. pnpm is not installed in this sandbox, so the literal pnpm commands could not run; the identical script bodies were executed via npm run test/lint/build instead. No product code and no existing tests were modified.
